correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the uniform proof for n≥3 over the stated field. The continuant recurrence is primitive linear in the last diagonal variable: the previous determinant is irreducible and cannot divide either the new edge variable or the lower-degree determinant. At corank one the symmetric adjugate is a nonzero multiple of vv^t, so a diagonal derivative is nonzero; at higher corank all cofactors vanish. Cutting all zero edges gives blocks of nullity at most one by the successive row equations, so corank at least two is equivalent to a cut with singular blocks on both sides. Each Z_i is the prime complete intersection of a cut variable and two integral block determinants on disjoint variables; each has points with every other edge nonzero, so no components are repeated or contained. For a set of cuts, work modulo their linear ideal: every prefix or suffix determinant in the sum of component ideals is a product containing the first or last block factor respectively, and those end factors are themselves among the equations. Thus the ideals, not just their zero sets, coincide. The two surviving factors use disjoint coordinates, so the homogeneous ideal is prime and saturated; the complete-intersection degrees and dimension yield the nonempty intersections and full simplex, including for n=3. For the generic node write the cut identity F=L R−b_i² P Q with P,Q the end cofactors; on the open where they are units, L/P and R/Q are the two boundary diagonal coordinates translated by functions independent of them. Together with b_i they give the exact transverse equation uv−w². Nonemptiness of that open follows from the displayed cofactor construction. The integral hypersurface has S2 and its singular strata have codimension two in it, giving R1 and normality. Summing the component degrees gives the stated binomial coefficient.
residual_risks: The finite-field checker is diagnostic; equality of homogeneous ideals and generic transverse type are established by the characteristic-zero proof, not the finite runs. The result does not address the Jacobian scheme or germs at crossings.
